title: Where Should the Code Go? Locating Foundation-Model Errors in Bitemporal Inventory Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Operational reports carry two clocks: when an event happened and when its report arrived; later reports can revise earlier ones. A foundation-model component that maintains the state supported by the reports visible at a cutoff, then rolls a supplied scenario forward, can be helped by exact code before it, after it or inside the call, or asked to reason harder. We ask which remedy removes which error, for which models, on an exactly solvable lost-sales inventory environment: 36,672 independently rescored requests over twelve configurations of closed and open-weight models, with a forced-answer-call interface as a control and protocols frozen before the calls. Weak models fail in separable ways. Canonical input removes report-selection error, exact continuation removes rollout error, neither repairs the other, and which error dominates differs by model; strong models are at ceiling on raw reports. translated_title: 代码应该放在哪里？在双时态库存模拟中定位基础模型错误
translated_abstract: 运营报告带有两个时钟：事件何时发生、其报告何时到达；后续报告还可能修改先前的报告。一个基础模型组件需要在截止时刻维护由可见报告所支持的状态，然后将给定的场景向前推演。我们可以通过在其之前、之后或调用内部放置精确代码来帮助它，也可以要求它进行更深入的推理。本文要回答的问题是：哪种补救措施能消除哪种错误、对哪些模型有效。研究在一个可精确求解的缺货损失库存环境中进行：在闭源与开源权重的十二种模型配置上，共执行了36,672次独立重新评分的请求，采用强制答案调用接口作为对照，并在调用之前冻结了全部评估协议。研究发现，弱模型以可分离的方式失败：规范化输入能消除报告选择错误，精确延续能消除推演错误，两者互不修复对方，且哪种错误占主导因模型而异；强模型在原始报告上已达到性能上限。而要求更多推理并非有效的替代手段。
tldr: 该论文在一个可精确求解的双时态库存模拟环境中系统定位基础模型错误，发现在模型调用前提供规范化输入可消除报告选择错误、调用后提供精确延续代码可消除场景推演错误，两种补救互不替代且主导错误因模型而异，而强模型在原始报告上已接近上限，单纯增加推理量并非有效补救。
en_tdlr: Using an exactly solvable bitemporal inventory simulation with 36,672 independently rescored requests across twelve model configurations, this paper disentangles foundation-model failures, showing that canonical input code removes report-selection errors and exact continuation code removes rollout errors—with neither substituting for the other, dominant errors varying by model, and strong models already at ceiling on raw reports.
